horoscope: Retrograde Venus moves back into your relationship sector today, dear Aries. While Venus will stay in this sector until December 4th, it remains retrograde only until November 13th. Until the 13th, you might often ponder whether you're getting satisfaction and harmony from a partner or close relationship. Or you may feel emotional distance or limbo during this review period, after which you'll start to put the pieces together and feel more confident about making changes. This is a good time to channel energy into refining a project, especially to make something more beautiful! Also today, you may feel a little under the weather or demotivated temporarily, and this is a signal to regroup. A Full Moon early tomorrow will grab your attention, but for now, unwind. Or, devote yourself to a cause or a learning opportunity.

Retrograde Venus moves back into your work and health sector today, dear Taurus, and for the next couple of weeks, you may be seeing areas of imbalance or dissatisfaction in your job or daily environment more acutely. Take heart, as the review you're doing now is necessary and is likely to lead to improved conditions in the long run. Venus moves in retrograde motion until November 13th but then continues to transit this sector until December 4th. This suggests you'll have many opportunities to bring harmony to your everyday life, perhaps through some trial and error. This is a strong time for refining a work in progress. With the Sun and Neptune at odds today, you may feel like you're missing something. This may be because you've forgotten to meet your needs for rest, spirituality, and spiritual replenishment, especially when it comes to your relationships. You are more sensitive than usual to imbalances in your environment and body. Something from your past, confusing dreams, or a feeling that you've missed a deadline or responsibility can nag at you. It's not the best time for making the big decisions, not only due to this aspect playing with your clarity, but also because we're building to a Full Moon in your sign.

From today until December 4th, you can be focused on harmony in your romantic life or on getting in touch with your creative muse, dear Gemini, as Venus transits your creative sector. It may not be until December that you feel that things are indeed moving forward, but this is a good time for looking at your creative and romantic life, as well as your hobbies and pleasures, from a different viewpoint or perspective. Venus will end its retrograde on November 13th, after which things seem to straighten out. Today's uncertainties are likely temporary, and they may be a cue to take a break. If you feel overworked or underappreciated, take care of your affairs or put them on hold until you feel the pleasure of certainty return. There may be a vague sense that something’s off or you’ve missed something, and you can be especially sensitive to imbalances in your love or social life. Aim to accept that you don’t have all the answers right now, as this can improve your comfort levels considerably!

Today and until December 4th, dear Cancer, you're likely to focus on bringing harmony, balance, and peace to your home life and family dynamics, as Venus retrogrades into your home and family sector. This can have its problems, not the least of which involves the resurfacing of old problems. However, you are looking at these matters in new ways and can apply your newfound insight after Venus turns direct on November 13th in rewarding and forward-looking ways. Also today, you may be feeling on the fence about a matter, and you can experience a bit of hesitation when it comes to expressing yourself openly and naturally. It's temporary and may only be a signal that you need a break that refreshes you or extra rest. Try not to let confusion about your larger goals interfere with the enjoyment of the moment, and resolve, instead, to pay more attention to them going forward.

Today and until December 4th, dear Leo, you can be quite focused on bringing more harmony to your communications, daily life, and friendships. Retrograde Venus returns to your solar third house today. You can particularly enjoy making others feel appreciated with your special attention, and you might focus on understanding matters from the past until November 13th, mainly related to your relationships. This can also be a time for returning to old conversations and projects or studies. Once Venus moves in direct (or "normal") motion after the 13th, you'll get the chance to come at problems in new and hopefully improved ways. Also today, you may feel the need to regroup, as restlessness or uncertainty are possible with a minor challenging aspect between the Sun and Neptune. It can especially be the case if you've been ignoring your needs for fantasy, imagination, and adventure in your life. It's best not to make waves just for now, with confidence taking a brief dip.

With Venus moving back into your resources sector today, dear Virgo, you're likely to focus on balancing your checkbook, upkeeping your valuables, beautifying your home (or yourself!), and attending to your personal comfort in the coming weeks (until December 4th). While Venus is retrograde in this sector of your solar chart until November 13th, you may review these things and look at them from a different perspective, sometimes quite critically. It can be a good time for finding lost objects, money, or areas of weakness in a budget. Mind you, there could be a delayed payment to deal with now, or if you've been dissatisfied with your income or business matters, you'll feel this more acutely now. Once Venus is direct, from November 13th onward, you can be motivated to make changes based on the reassessments you've made. Also today, a Sun-Neptune transit can point to a need to make adjustments. It may be even better to observe before making edits. Energies active now can point to some teetering between wanting to keep things light and straightforward, and craving more depth and meaning from your interactions. As a result, there can be mixed signals and difficulty concentrating. Enthusiasm may take a dip, but this is temporary and perhaps only a message that you need to regroup and rest or take a break from overthinking.

Retrograde Venus backs up into your sign today, dear Libra, and will continue to transit Libra until December 4th. Until November 13th, Venus remains retrograde, giving you an opportunity to look at yourself, your personal goals, and your image in a new light. There can be quite a bit of preoccupation with your personal affairs now, and it's a good time to review what exactly has been working for you and what may have been working against you. Take notes! It's a truly powerful time for gaining perspective. It's important to save major changes until after the 13th, but until then, you'll have opportunities to make these assessments. Delays are quite possible, but sometimes they can give you time to rethink things. Decision-making can be off today, and you may feel rather out of touch with your intuition, making it difficult to trust your instincts. You may be endlessly weighing the pros and cons of a situation, which keeps you in an uncomfortable (and unproductive) state of limbo. You can be hesitant or uncertain, but it's temporary.

Venus leaves your sign today, but isn't moving forward, dear Scorpio! In fact, Venus is moving back into the sign behind yours in retrograde motion. While this retrograde period will only last until November 13th, Venus will continue this journey of your privacy sector until December 4th. From now until then, your affections may stay especially private as you sort out what you honestly and sincerely want. A focus on the past is likely now. People from your past might re-enter your life, either in the flesh or strongly in your mind. You experience a stronger need or desire to sort things out. You can't always depend on others for closure, so be careful not to attach yourself too strongly to something that you may not entirely understand. Today, relationships may have you feeling a little off-center. Try not to obsess over the past, even if buried resentments surface now. While it is certainly important for you to review the past these days, doing so with the future in mind may be best. Avoidance is not the answer either. You're likely experiencing a temporary lull that slows you down long enough to explore alternate routes and to make important adjustments. If you feel you're lagging behind, try not to let it hold you back any further. Later today, emotions are stronger but also clearer.

Starting today and until December 4th, Venus transits your sector of friends, hopes, and wishes, dear Sagittarius. Because Venus is retrograde in this sector until November 13th, you may renew attention to past relationships and gain a new perspective on old issues, connections, and friendships. As well--or alternatively--you may be reassessing a project or pursuit in terms of how much satisfaction you're getting from it. After the 13th, you may be more actively or outwardly working toward harmony and balance with friends. Today, you might wrestle with some restlessness until you acknowledge the need to check in with your intuition. All of a sudden, you may not feel as clear about your next step or how to wrap something up. If so, consider it temporary and a signal to slow down. We're heading toward a Full Moon, and as the day advances, feelings blossom.

Venus retreats into your career sector in retrograde motion today, dear Capricorn. Until December 4th, you take a stronger interest in harmonizing with bosses, parents, elders, or more experienced people. You're also considering ways to improve your reputation or your relationship to your career and responsibilities. You may not feel particularly or fully supported until after November 13th, but you can be gaining valuable insight into your working relationships, reputation, and the satisfaction you're feeling for your current work projects or long-term goals. Also today, there may be a misunderstanding or some off-timing that could leave you feeling a little insecure, but it's temporary. People, groups, or relationships that you have been idealizing could prove a little disappointing. Aim to keep your center and seek out activities that keep your mind busy.

Retrograde Venus retreats into your adventure sector today, dear Aquarius, after a relatively lengthy visit to your career sector. This can mean a review of (or return to) an unfinished matter or previous condition related to travel, education, special interests, or publishing. You may feel a little stuck in the past or in limbo during the retrograde that lasts until November 13th, after which you have some time with Venus moving in direct ("normal") motion in this sector to resolve matters and take affirmative action based on your discoveries. It's a beautiful time to connect with people who expand your perspective. It may be better to decompress, wind yourself down, and take it easy today. A minor challenging aspect between the Sun and Neptune today can leave you feeling vaguely guilty or uncertain. You may be doubting things temporarily, but this may only be a signal that you need a checkpoint, especially if you've been neglecting your need to feed your imagination.

Retrograde Venus moves back into your solar eighth house today, dear Pisces. While it will remain retrograde only until November 13th, Venus will stay in this sector of your chart until December 4th. Until the 13th, you may be reviewing your financial arrangements or obligations. You may be looking at your intimate life or your dependencies from a different angle, and reassessing whether you're satisfied with how you've been approaching these matters or with your return on investments! This review can give you valuable clues for making changes, which are ideally made after the retrograde period. Also today, some uncertainty or wavering confidence can remind you to honor your need for imagination, daydreaming, and spiritual sustenance, because if you ignore these things, you may get to a state of easy distraction and restlessness. Take time to unwind and regroup. A Full Moon is about to occur, and it's sure to bring more excitement to your life, and it's wise to center yourself now.
